notes.title: Update numer cztery!
notes.content:
Hello players!

We have just uploaded a new build with two exciting updates.

No. 1
Few text clouds in the intro are no longer cropped and the text is now fully visible. (there were only few letters cropped out before)

No. 2
We have added a support for total of 18 new languages to the game!
But - only for the game's interface for now.

We'd love to add new languages for dialogues (or at least just for subtitles), but we still need to see if we'll be able to do that.

Oh, and one more thing!
Don't forget to download your free copy of "2N1C" soundtrack with extended versions of the tracks from the game!
Get it right here - http://store.steampowered.com/app/622500/

Best,
Maciej

notes.title: Das update nummer drei!
notes.content:
Hello players!

We have just uploaded an update to the Steam servers including some improvements from your suggestions 

- Analog stick support added
- More checkpoints on the first map added
- Rare crash on the jumping-jellies fixed 
- Bug involving platforms on the second map fixed
- Two checkpoints that were too close to the falling pit moved a bit further

Have a great week!

Best,
Maciej

notes.title: L'Update numéro deux
notes.content:
Hey there, it's us again, coming with a small update.

Since some confusion on how to get your gamepads working, we have added a simple notification in the main menu, letting you know you have to enable your gamepad in the controls configuration if you want to use it in the game. This was quite confusing for some, since the gamepad worked in the menu, but not in the game. Note that this notification will be shown only when you have a controller plugged in.

Also, seeing desperate trial and error of some, we have added an additional checkpoint, just after the first mob you encounter.

Have fun!

Best,
Maciej

notes.title: Update numero uno!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

We're really glad to hear a lot of great stuff about "2 Ninjas 1 Cup" despite its name and lack of hentai anime lolitas.

Since our grand premiere we've had a total of ONE bug report. It took our programmer a total of 30 minutes to resolve the problem and upload new builds to Steam servers, which you can now download.

But we'd like to congratulate Velox on finding that one, as it was a damn tricky one to induce.

So yeah, feliz navidad, Velox, or something.

Carry on.
